Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.label: waiting period
Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.description: Cover begins after the waiting period.
Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.text: Cover begins after the waiting period, which begins after cover begins.

Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.label: accidents and cooking
Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.text: An accident is a sudden external event. Thrumbos are external. Your cooking is not.

Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.label: acts of the storyteller
Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.description: Weather damage is a grey zone.
Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.text: Acts of Storyteller are excluded unless the Storyteller acted reasonably.

Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.label: raids and sieges
Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.description: Sieges and mechanoid clusters are a grey zone.
Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.text: Raids are not war. Sieges are war. Mechanoid clusters are weather.

Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.label: pre-existing conditions
Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.description: Damage that was there before is deducted.
Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.text: Pre-existing conditions include conditions that existed before, during or shortly after this policy.

Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.label: self-inflicted damage
Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.description: Damage done by your own people is excluded.
Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.text: Self-inflicted damage includes damage by you, your colonists, your animals, your turrets and anyone standing near them.

Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.label: walls and doors
Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.description: A broken door is a grey zone.
Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.text: Walls must be walls. A wall with a door in it is a door.

Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.label: the other clause
Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.description: One more day of review. From Overbooked a grey zone.
Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.text: Clause 17 is attached separately, in Thrumbo.

Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.label: bionic parts
Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.text: Bionic parts are equipment and are insured under Muffalo & Machine Cover, which you do not have.

Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.label: regrowth
Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.description: If a lost part grows back, so does the claim.
Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.text: If a lost part grows back, so does our claim.

Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.label: assessment and death
Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.description: Dying before the assessment ends the assessment.
Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.text: Dying before the assessment ends the assessment.

Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.label: changes in risk
Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.text: Changes in risk must be reported within one day. This includes swords.

Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.label: form C-7
Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.description: Cancellations can come back with a form error.
Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.text: Cancellations require Form C-7, signed in triplicate, in an ink colour we have on file.

Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.label: automatic renewal
Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.text: Your policy renews automatically to spare you the burden of deciding.

Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.label: conflict of interest
Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.description: From Overbooked, Legal Shield does not help against Clawback Mutual.
Silverline.SL_ClauseDef.text: Legal Shield does not cover disputes with Clawback Mutual, for reasons we are not required to explain.

Silverline.SL_LimbScheduleDef.label: Schedule of Limbs
Silverline.SL_LimbScheduleDef.description: The standard schedule (Anhang B.2) is built in. Add lines for modded body parts here.
